# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Applied the pending reproduction and habitat-probe amendments end to end. In `spawning()`, current crowding now caps same-day spawn readiness so sudden density spikes suppress berried-female creation immediately instead of waiting for the readiness EMA, and the berried event summary now reports the effective vs baseline readiness when density is limiting. In `reproductive_readiness_factors()`, GH/mineral pressure is now part of the named factor set so low-GH suppression can surface as `minerals` in snapshots and diagnostics. I also extended `crates/tank_core/tests/reproduction_factors.rs` with direct coverage for immediate density suppression, GH/mineral parameter tuning, and mineral-dominant suppression labels, and fixed `probe_light_depth_shallow_vs_deep_growth` to rescale all dissolved totals after geometry changes and reseed the stability tracker so shallow/deep comparisons isolate depth-driven light effects instead of stale chemistry concentrations.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the shrimp reproduction flow and the habitat geometry probe fixture to confirm the reported amendment gaps and choose minimal fixes that preserved the existing model shape.
2. [Completed] Patched shrimp reproduction so density constrains same-day spawning, added GH/mineral suppression to the named reproductive factor set, and extended reproduction regression coverage for the new density and mineral behaviors.
3. [Completed] Corrected the habitat light-depth probe to rescale dissolved totals after fill-height changes, reseeded its stability baseline, formatted the code, and ran targeted regression tests.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture` passed with 14/14 tests, including the new immediate-density and mineral-observability coverage plus the long-horizon stable/neglected scenarios.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_habitat_geometry_probes probe_light_depth_shallow_vs_deep_growth -- --nocapture` passed.

## Outstanding Risks

- I did not run the full workspace test suite or the full `tank_harness` integration suite; validation was targeted to the reproduction regressions and the corrected light-depth habitat probe.
